message: The other night, we had a sudden power outage, and I found myself fumbling around for flashlights while the kids giggled at how we were living like pioneers. Our family group chat turned into a lively exchange of what snacks we could still eat and who could locate the best lantern. It was a fun reminder that even in the dark, we could stay connected and comfortable with a little planning. Now I keep a power bank charged and a few handy lights ready, just in case we decide to go off-grid for a bit again. What’s your favorite snack for a cozy night in?
